description: This file defines two converter classes for a Windows UI application, converting item sizes to visibility states for UI elements.

classes.name: ItemSizeToVisibilityConverter
classes.description: Converts an integer item count to a visibility state, showing or hiding UI elements based on whether the count is zero.

classes.name: ItemSizeToVisibilityNegationConverter
classes.description: Converts an integer item count to a visibility state, showing or hiding UI elements based on whether the count is greater than zero.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts an integer item count to a visibility state (visible if zero, collapsed otherwise).
